mapper.sql: r.ra_id, r.ra_no, r.plant_cd, r.ra_type, r.method, r.matrix_cd, r.title, r.scope_text, r.assess_date, r.status, r.prev_ra_id, pr.ra_no as prev_ra_no, r.apr_id, r.released_at, r.released_by, r.remark, r.row_ver, r.updated_at, r.updated_by, (select count(*) from cms_risk_item i where i.ra_id = r.ra_id) as item_cnt, (select count(*) from cms_risk_item i where i.ra_id = r.ra_id and i.risk_level = 'HIGH') as high_cnt, (select count(*) from cms_risk_item i where i.ra_id = r.ra_id and i.done_date is null and i.risk_level in ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH')) as open_cnt, (select count(*) from cms_risk_item i where i.ra_id = r.ra_id and i.done_date is null and i.due_date < #{today}) as overdue_cnt, (select count(*) from cms_risk_member m where m.ra_id = r.ra_id) as member_cnt
mapper.select:
select from cms_risk_assess r left join cms_risk_assess pr on pr.ra_id = r.prev_ra_id
order by r.assess_date desc, r.ra_id desc limit #{limit}

select from cms_risk_assess r left join cms_risk_assess pr on pr.ra_id = r.prev_ra_id
order by
r.ra_no r.title r.ra_type r.status r.assess_date
desc,
r.ra_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select ra_id from cms_risk_assess where ra_id = #{id} for update

insert into cms_risk_assess (comp_cd, ra_no, plant_cd, ra_type, method, matrix_cd, title, scope_text, assess_date, prev_ra_id, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{r.raNo}, #{r.plantCd}, #{r.raType}, #{r.method}, #{r.matrixCd}, #{r.title}, #{r.scopeText}, #{r.assessDate}, #{r.prevRaId}, #{r.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning ra_id
mapper.sql: i.item_id, i.seq, i.task_text, i.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, i.hazard_cat, i.hazard_text, i.current_measure, i.likelihood, i.severity, i.risk_level, i.plan_measure, i.owner_user_id, u.login_id as owner_login_id, u.user_nm as owner_nm, i.due_date, i.done_date, i.residual_l, i.residual_s, i.residual_level, i.row_ver
from cms_risk_item i left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = i.equip_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = i.owner_user_id
mapper.select: select where i.ra_id = #{raId} order by i.seq

insert into cms_risk_item (comp_cd, ra_id, seq, task_text, equip_id, hazard_cat, hazard_text, current_measure, likelihood, severity, risk_level, plan_measure, owner_user_id, due_date, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{raId}, #{i.seq}, #{i.taskText}, #{i.equipId}, #{i.hazardCat}, #{i.hazardText}, #{i.currentMeasure}, #{i.likelihood}, #{i.severity}, #{i.riskLevel}, #{i.planMeasure}, #{i.ownerUserId}, #{i.dueDate}, #{by}, #{by}) returning item_id
select count(*) from cms_risk_item where ra_id = #{raId} and item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.delete: delete from cms_risk_item where ra_id = #{raId} and item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: insert into cms_risk_item (comp_cd, ra_id, seq, task_text, equip_id, hazard_cat, hazard_text, current_measure, likelihood, severity, risk_level, plan_measure, owner_user_id, due_date, created_by, updated_by) select i.comp_cd, #{toRaId}, i.seq, i.task_text, (select e.equip_id from mst_equip e where e.equip_id = i.equip_id and e.use_yn = 'Y'), i.hazard_cat, i.hazard_text, -- 끝낸 개선 대책은 새 평가의 "현재 조치"로 넘어간다(500자 안에서) left(nullif(coalesce(i.current_measure, '') || case when i.done_date is not null and i.plan_measure is not null then case when i.current_measure is null then '' else ' / ' end || i.plan_measure else '' end, ''), 500), coalesce(i.residual_l, i.likelihood), coalesce(i.residual_s, i.severity), coalesce(i.residual_level, i.risk_level), case when i.done_date is null then i.plan_measure end, case when i.done_date is null then (select u.user_id from sys_user u where u.user_id = i.owner_user_id and u.use_yn = 'Y') end, case when i.done_date is null then i.due_date end, #{by}, #{by} from cms_risk_item i where i.ra_id = #{fromRaId}
mapper.select: select m.member_id, m.user_id, u.login_id, m.worker_id, w.worker_cd, m.member_nm, m.role_cd, m.participated_on, m.notified_on, m.remark, m.row_ver from cms_risk_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id left join mst_worker w on w.worker_id = m.worker_id where m.ra_id = #{raId} order by m.member_id

insert into cms_risk_member (comp_cd, ra_id, user_id, worker_id, member_nm, role_cd, participated_on, notified_on, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{raId}, #{m.userId}, #{m.workerId}, #{m.memberNm}, #{m.roleCd}, #{m.participatedOn}, #{m.notifiedOn}, #{m.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning member_id
select w.worker_id, w.worker_cd, w.worker_nm, w.plant_cd from mst_worker w where w.use_yn = 'Y' order by w.worker_cd limit #{limit}
select w.worker_id, w.worker_cd, w.worker_nm, w.plant_cd from mst_worker w where w.worker_cd = #{workerCd} and w.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.delete: delete from cms_risk_member where ra_id = #{raId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select a.status from cms_risk_item i join cms_risk_assess a on a.ra_id = i.ra_id where i.item_id = #{itemId}
